summary: Modulprüfungsordnung Musik L3 of 30.01.2023: required electives are one of Modul 1A/1B (10 ECTS; 1A continues only as 6A, 1B only as 6B), one of Modul 6A/6B (10 ECTS), one of Modul 9A/9B/9C (10 ECTS), and one Praxemble module 11A or 11B (5 ECTS). Choices inside a module (instrument, ensemble, course options) are not encoded. Modul 13 is compulsory (in-module instrument choice only). The § 4 (3) choice between modules 10 and 14, and between 11 and 16, selects which grade enters the state exam; both modules in each pair are still taken.

categories.name: Artistic Practice 1 (1A or 1B)
categories.note: One 10-ECTS module. Choosing 1A locks Modul 6A; choosing 1B locks Modul 6B.

categories.name: Artistic Practice 2 (6A or 6B)
categories.note: One 10-ECTS module. 6A only after 1A; 6B only after 1B.

categories.name: Praxemble (school music or world music)
categories.nameDe: Praxemble (Schulmusiken oder Musiken der Welt, Modul 11A/11B)
